description: Notification sent to student when an academic integrity hearing is scheduled
subject: Academic Integrity Hearing Scheduled - Case $case_id
body:
Dear $student_name,

A hearing has been scheduled regarding academic integrity case $case_id.

Hearing Details:
- Date: $hearing_date
- Time: $hearing_time
- Location: $location

Please arrive 10 minutes before the scheduled time. You may bring supporting documentation and/or a representative.

If you have any questions or need to reschedule, please contact the Office of Academic Integrity.

Sincerely,
Office of Academic Integrity
